# Agents ask for compute through the board

## Context

A worker that needs more machines has no way to say so except failing.

## Decision

`pulse compute request` writes a request the owner approves or denies from the console; approved requests provision a hand under the configured caps.

## Consequences

Compute stays owner-bounded: caps, a daily hour budget and credits live in settings.
